desc: Establish the bounded-hop/chordless shortest-path structure for co-interval graphs (at most four edges).
Derive candidate direct, one-, two-, and three-internal-vertex path formulas using left/right extreme intervals.
Fix the signed-64-bit sentinel overflow and pass both public samples.
Validate the implementation by randomized brute force against Dijkstra and resolve discrepancies.
Finalize the memory-conscious Python implementation and complexity argument.
